title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
engineRationale: Fyodor Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment is the quintessential psychological autopsy of rationalized guilt, intellectual pride, and moral resurrection. Antidote's expressive character rigs, psychological micro-reactions (sweat, shock, fire), dynamic tension sets (stifling garret, foggy Petersburg streets, police interrogation office), and symbolic motifs (scales, doors, cross, coins, clock) deliver maximum viewer engagement and narrative clarity without uncanny photorealism.
